shared.generator: modules/genmedia.py image; volcengine doubao-seedream-5-0-pro-260628; --size 2560x1440 --n 1; no --ref (see user_refs)
shared.prompt_structure: orthographic plan-view camera sentence (SOUL duty 3 rule 1) + scene body in English with openings written as wall-line gaps and wall-face elements explicitly excluded (rules 2-3) + clean-base sentence (no people/animals/text/arrows) + style.json style_fragment_ui verbatim. Negative = negative_prompt_en verbatim + SOUL plan-view negatives + people/animal/text terms. All 8 scenes are dream-layer, so negative_prompt_waking_addon_en was not applied. Exact strings are in each scene's prompts.json.
shared.mucha_layer: Dream scenes carry the full Mucha / Art Nouveau layer through the verbatim style segment. The plan bodies mention only ornament visible from above (eaves mosaic, gutter brackets, hearth tile band, whiplash flora lines).
shared.coordinates: layout.json xy were recalibrated against each delivered image. Bearings were then rechecked, and two views were re-aimed after recalibration (pigeon tile 9, duchess-front tile 7). extent_m gives metres for the full image (x right, y down), so metric position = xy * extent_m.

items.design_check: Matches the cards. The lane is at the top (north) with the stone path to the front door. The slate roof runs east-west with loose slates near the chimney. A broad chimney with two clay pots stands at the east end. The eaves carry the pastel-and-gold mosaic band and gilded brackets. Roses line the south wall. The cucumber-frame is under the south wall, bare level ground is at the south-east ladder corner, and the apple tree and dug patch are lower left. A paling fence with flowing tops separates the yard from the wood. The west gable is sunlit and shadows fall east.
image_defects: minor: the chimney stack stands attached just outside the east gable end instead of rising from the gable. Accepted, the position still reads as 'at the east gable'.

items.design_check: Door gap at the west end of the north wall with the leaf swung inward. Chest of drawers on the north wall, washstand with bottle on the west wall, narrow fireplace with a vine-carved mantel on the east wall, rag rug in the centre. Table with fan and gloves plus a rush chair at the single south window gap. The sunbeam slants across the floor toward the fireplace.
image_defects: minor: the inner wall faces are visible, so the room reads as a deep box (slight perspective) rather than a pure plan
minor: the room is drawn wider than its 3.0 x 2.7 m proportion (floor about 1.35:1)

items.design_check: Correct: the path runs west-east, the great oak with spreading roots stands north of the path, the limestone door-frame and threshold stone are on its south face, and a warm pool of western sun lights the threshold. Deviations are listed under image_defects.
image_defects: major: my prompt said 'canopy and upper trunks cut away at head height', and every tree, including the veteran oak, was drawn as a sawn-off felled stump with visible growth rings. The card describes a living ancient oak.
minor: a dark pipe-like man-made object lies on the path east of the door (about x 0.81, y 0.73). It is anachronistic.
minor: a stained-glass mosaic disc lies on the forest floor at the top left. The card has no built ornament on the ground.

items.design_check: Matches the kitchen card's interior layout. The west hearth has a cauldron on a crane and a sooted whiplash-vine tile band, with the hearth slab and rag rug in front. Copper pans hang on the east wall. The south door gap has its leaf swung inward between two window gaps, with geraniums on a sill. Pepper haze is thickest at the hearth, with firelight against pale daylight at the door.
